crossRefs.note: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?
Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?
What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?
‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’
Therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”
Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.
“Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”
It was so, that after Yahweh had spoken these words to Job, Yahweh said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled…
Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.
For if he who comes preaches another Jesus, whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit, which you…
For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.
I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.
I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way…

translations.web: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.

translations.kjv: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior
translations.asv: What ye know, the same do I know also: I am not inferior unto you.
